title: Fieldwork
subtitle: A clearer path from expertise to inquiry.
label: Concept / Demo
problem: A fictional consultancy needs to explain a complex service and help prospective clients take the next step without navigating a maze of pages.
goal: Make the offer understandable, show a focused service journey and keep the experience useful on a small screen.
approach: An editorial hierarchy leads from a concise proposition to service details and a brief builder. A responsive preview demonstrates how the same content adapts across devices.
deliverables: Service discovery and clear calls to action
technology: Semantic HTML, responsive CSS, vanilla JavaScript
outcome: Not measured. This is an original illustrative concept, not commissioned client work.

title: Operations Pulse
subtitle: From scattered numbers to a useful view.
label: Concept / Demo
problem: A fictional operations team needs a consistent view of orders, revenue and contribution across regions and reporting periods.
goal: Let a decision-maker explore a small dataset, understand exactly what each measure represents and inspect the underlying records.
approach: A single synthetic dataset drives the KPIs, monthly revenue chart and accessible table. Period and region controls recalculate every view; CSV export makes the filtered records portable.
deliverables: Accessible source table and CSV export
technology: JavaScript aggregation, semantic tables, CSS visualization
outcome: Not measured. All figures are synthetic and are not NAND Lab or client business results.
